Here is the step-by-step tutorial:

### Part 1: Google Cloud Setup (Get Client ID & Secret)

1.  **Go to Google Cloud Console:**
    *   Visit [console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com/) and sign in with the Gmail account you want to send emails from.
2.  **Create a Project:**
    *   Click the project dropdown (top left) > **New Project**.
    *   Name it "PawFriends POS" and click **Create**.
3.  **Enable Gmail API:**
    *   In the search bar at the top, type **"Gmail API"**.
    *   Select it and click **Enable**.
4.  **Configure Consent Screen:**
    *   Go to **APIs & Services > OAuth consent screen**.
    *   Select **External** (unless you have a Google Workspace organization, then choose Internal). Click **Create**.
    *   **App Name:** PawFriends POS.
    *   **User Support Email:** Select your email.
    *   **Developer Contact Info:** Enter your email.
    *   Click **Save and Continue**.
    *   **Scopes:** Skip this page (Save and Continue).
    *   **Test Users:** Click **Add Users** and enter your *own* Gmail address. (This is crucial while the app is in "Testing" mode).
5.  **Create Credentials:**
    *   Go to **APIs & Services > Credentials**.
    *   Click **+ Create Credentials** > **OAuth client ID**.
    *   **Application type:** Select **Web application**.
    *   **Name:** "PawFriends Web".
    *   **Authorized redirect URIs:** (⚠️ **Important Step**)
        *   Click **+ Add URI**.
        *   Paste exactly this URL: `https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground`
        *   *Reason: We need this to generate the token in Part 2.*
    *   Click **Create**.
6.  **Copy Your Keys:**
    *   A popup will show your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
    *   Copy these to a notepad.

---

### Part 2: OAuth Playground (Get Refresh Token)

This step authorizes your app permanently so it doesn't ask for a password again.

1.  **Go to OAuth Playground:**
    *   Visit [developers.google.com/oauthplayground](https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground).
2.  **Configure Settings:**
    *   Click the **Gear Icon (⚙️)** in the top right.
    *   Check the box **"Use your own OAuth credentials"**.
    *   Paste your **OAuth Client ID** and **OAuth Client Secret** from Part 1.
    *   Click Close.
3.  **Select Scope:**
    *   In the "Input your own scopes" box on the left, paste this URL:
        `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send`
    *   Click **Authorize APIs** (Blue Button).
4.  **Login & Authorize:**
    *   It will ask you to sign in with your Google Account.
    *   **Warning Screen:** Google might say "Google hasn't verified this app". This is normal because you just created it.
        *   Click **Advanced** > **Go to PawFriends POS (unsafe)**.
    *   Click **Continue** / **Allow** to grant permission to send emails.
5.  **Exchange Codes:**
    *   You will be redirected back to the Playground.
    *   Click the blue button **"Exchange authorization code for tokens"**.
6.  **Get the Refresh Token:**
    *   Look at the JSON response on the right side.
    *   Copy the long string labeled **"refresh_token"**.

---

### Part 3: Enter into PawFriends POS

Go back to your application's **Settings > Notifications Configuration**:

1.  **Client ID:** Paste from Part 1.
2.  **Client Secret:** Paste from Part 1.
3.  **Refresh Token:** Paste from Part 2.
4.  Click **Save Config**.

2.  **Strict Filtering**: Once you select a discount (e.g., "Summer Sale"), the system checks every item in your cart. If an item **already has that specific discount ID**, it is completely hidden from the list. You will only see items that are eligible to receive it.

### **`pages/POS.tsx`**

*   **Updated Modal Logic**:
    *   Added a placeholder view: *"Select a discount from the left to view eligible items"* when the modal first opens.
    *   Implemented strict filtering in the render loop: `if (alreadyApplied) return null;`. This ensures products with the selected discount are removed from the view immediately.
    *   Added a "All items applied" message if the filtered list becomes empty because every item in the cart already has that specific promo.

### **Part 2: How to Get Client ID, Secret, and Refresh Token**

Because your Client ID and Secret are static (unless you deleted the credential in Google Cloud), you can retrieve them. However, **you must generate a new Refresh Token** because it is only shown once.

#### **Step 1: Retrieve Client ID and Secret**
1.  Go to the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/).
2.  Select your project from the top dropdown.
3.  In the left sidebar, go to **APIs & Services** > **Credentials**.
4.  Under "OAuth 2.0 Client IDs", find the credential you created earlier (it might be named "PawFriends" or similar).
5.  Click the **Edit icon (pencil)** or the name of the credential.
6.  On the right side, you will see your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**. Copy these.

#### **Step 2: Generate a NEW Refresh Token**
You cannot view the old refresh token. You must generate a new one using the OAuth 2.0 Playground.

1.  Go to [Google OAuth 2.0 Playground](https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground).
2.  Click the **Gear Icon (Settings)** in the top right.
3.  Check the box **"Use your own OAuth credentials"**.
4.  Paste your **OAuth Client ID** and **OAuth Client Secret** (from Step 1) into the boxes.
5.  Click **Close**.
6.  In the left list of APIs, find and select **Gmail API v1**.
    *   Click `https://mail.google.com/` (or the specific scope you used before, usually `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send`).
7.  Click the blue **Authorize APIs** button.
8.  Sign in with the Google Account you want to send emails from (e.g., your shop's Gmail).
9.  Click **Continue** if you see a "Google hasn't verified this app" warning (since it's your own private app).
10. Click **Allow** to grant permissions.
11. You will be redirected back to the Playground.
12. Click the blue **Exchange authorization code for tokens** button.
13. The box will populate with a **Refresh Token**. Copy this long string.

#### **Step 3: Update App Settings**
1.  Open your PawFriends App.
2.  Go to **Settings** > **Notifications Configuration**.
3.  Paste the **Client ID**, **Client Secret**, and the **NEW Refresh Token**.
4.  Click **Save Config**. (This will now work because I fixed the database error in the code above).

To fix the `invalid_client` error, I have updated `StoreContext.tsx`.

### **What caused the error?**
The error occurred because the application was falling back to use old "Legacy" credentials (likely from EmailJS or TextBee configurations) as the Google OAuth Client ID when the specific Google fields were empty or null in the database. Since these old keys are not valid Google OAuth Client IDs, Google rejected them with `invalid_client`.

### **The Fix**
I have removed the fallback logic. Now, if you haven't explicitly set up the Google Gmail Direct credentials, the system will see them as empty (and thus disabled) instead of trying to use incorrect legacy data.

### **Next Steps Required from You:**
1.  **Apply the update.**
2.  Go to **Settings > Notifications Configuration**.
3.  You might see the Google fields are empty (or they might show your previously entered data if it saved correctly).
4.  **Re-enter** your **Client ID**, **Client Secret**, and **Refresh Token** carefully.
    *   Ensure there are **no spaces** at the beginning or end of the strings.
5.  Click **Save Config**.

This will ensure a clean save to the database using the correct mapping I provided in the previous step, and the system will use *only* these correct credentials for sending emails.

The error `invalid_client` specifically means that Google **does not recognize the Client ID or Client Secret** you are sending. This usually happens for two reasons:
1.  **Hidden Spaces:** Copy-pasting often adds invisible spaces at the start or end of the text.
2.  **Mismatch:** You generated a new Refresh Token using a *different* Client ID in the OAuth Playground than the one saved in your app settings.

I have updated the code to **automatically trim spaces** when you save and provide better error messages.

### **Steps to Fix:**
1.  **Apply the code update below.**
2.  Go to **Settings > Notifications Configuration**.
3.  **Delete** the existing Client ID, Secret, and Refresh Token text completely.
4.  **Re-paste** them carefully:
    *   **Client ID:** Must end in `.apps.googleusercontent.com`.
    *   **Client Secret:** Ensure it matches the Client ID above.
    *   **Refresh Token:** Ensure this token was generated using *the exact Client ID and Secret you just pasted*. If you used different credentials in the Playground, you must generate a new token again using *these* credentials.
5.  Click **Save Config**.
6.  Try sending an email again.
